summary: Kidoz Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its audited financial results for fiscal year 2025. The filing reports record revenue of $18.4M and net income of $456,817, with no mention of any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, restructuring, or management change. The filing is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. earnings press release, with no transactional or corporate action components. The content focuses solely on financial highlights and operational commentary.
